items.title: fix(agents): retire warm CLI sessions before manual compaction (#157766)
items.summary: fix(agents): retire warm CLI sessions before manual compaction (#157766) fix(cli-runner): retire the warm CLI process after manual compaction After a manual /compact on a native CLI backend (for example claude-cli), the previous warm CLI process stayed alive and the next turn reused it, so the model kept working from pre-compaction context. Compaction now retires the warm process through the existing serialized queue, and the next turn starts a fresh process with the compacted history. Ordinary turns still reuse the warm process, and other sessions are unaffected. Proof: built Gateway with a recording fake Claude CLI, shipped /compact: on main the next turn reused the same PID with pre-compaction history; the candidate retires that PID and resumes in a new process with compacted history. Ordinary-turn reuse and a second session are unchanged. Fixes #157483. Thanks @deepujain. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: perf: reuse prepared session source authority (#171353)
items.summary: perf: reuse prepared session source authority (#171353) Reuse the selecting entry reader's retained predicate during source preparation, removing the duplicate worker read. Borrowers share the selector's lifetime; releasing a borrower does not revoke its owner, while owner disposal revokes borrowers. Conversation authority and checks at the actual worker effect remain intact. Regression coverage includes unrelated writes, selected-field revocation, reset/delete/recreate, and both release directions. Codex review is clean at P0/P1. Required CI/static gates are verified before merge. The integrated L2 harness pair has unchanged warm causal SQL/requests: 124 [124–129] statements and 34 [34–36] requests, with MAIN 0. No whole-sink T1 retirement is claimed. Per-PR scope is four files, +59/-24.
